summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend testing of StudioHub AI commercial pipeline (Orçamentos, Contratos) + AI Assistant. 33/33 pytest tests passed. All new UI flows validated via Playwright including quote conversions and contract digital signature. AI chat via OpenAI gpt-5.4 returned coherent Portuguese responses referencing unpaid clients.

issues: CRA/Webpack dev overlay shows 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' on some route changes. It is a known cosmetic warning from framer-motion / Radix layouts and does NOT reproduce with plain user interaction (no console errors captured after dismissal). In production build the overlay will not appear. Consider adding a global ResizeObserver polyfill suppressor if the warning is undesirable.
Orçamentos & Contratos dialogs correctly include <DialogDescription> now — the previous a11y warning is resolved for these dialogs.

action_items: (Low, cosmetic) Suppress ResizeObserver loop warning in dev by adding `window.addEventListener('error', (e) => { if (e.message.includes('ResizeObserver loop')) { e.stopImmediatePropagation(); } })` in index.js so the CRA overlay does not appear during navigation.
(Low) Consider adding server-side filter `/api/contracts?client_id=` and `/api/quotes?client_id=` — ClientDetail currently loads all contracts/quotes and filters by name client-side.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 950+ lines. Overdue for split into routers/{clients,sessions,galleries,quotes,contracts,invoices,ai,templates}.py + models.py.
Auto-numbering for Invoice / Quote / Contract uses `count_documents + 1`. Race-prone under concurrent POSTs. Use a Mongo counters collection with atomic $inc for production safety.

POST /api/ai/chat does not replay previous session messages to the LLM — only the new user message is sent. The endpoint stores history but never re-injects it, so multi-turn context is lost between requests within the same session_id. Consider fetching prior turns from db.ai_messages and calling chat.add_message() before send_message() for continuity.

AI chat exposes the studio's full client list, invoice totals, and unpaid amounts as system-prompt context. This is intentional but there is no way for the user to opt out. Document this behaviour or make context injection configurable.

quote_to_contract() uses the hard-coded 'servicos' template even when the source quote used a specialised template (e.g. casamento). Consider mapping the quote template id to a matching contract template when available.

Sign endpoint (POST /contracts/{id}/sign) does not verify the contract exists BEFORE the update — an unknown id passes the update_one silently then falls through to the 404 check. It works but should short-circuit with a find_one first for symmetry with other endpoints.

Frontend AiChat sessionRef persists per component mount but is NOT saved to localStorage — refreshing the page loses the conversation even though history exists on the server. Consider persisting session_id in localStorage and pre-loading /api/ai/history on mount.
Orcamentos.jsx save() button has no loading state; a slow network could allow double-submit and duplicate quote numbers.
Contratos.jsx sign() uses view.id without disabling the button while awaiting — could double-sign. Minor.
All new interactive elements have consistent data-testid attributes — excellent testability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 fully passes. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (33 tests, ~5s) covers: templates, quotes CRUD + auto-numbering ORC-YYYY-NNNN + status + conversions (to invoice with matching totals; to contract with template body auto-filled + quote link), contracts CRUD + auto-numbering CTR-YYYY-NNNN + template body auto-fill + patch status + sign (requires non-empty signer_name, sets status=assinado + signed_at), AI chat (real OpenAI gpt-5.4 ~3-8s, verifies Portuguese reply mentions unpaid clients Ana/Ferreira/pendente), AI history endpoint, + regression on clients/sessions/invoices/dashboard/seed. Frontend Playwright validated: Orçamentos create-with-template → send → approve → convert-to-contract → convert-to-invoice → delete; Contratos create-from-template with auto-filled body → view → sign digitally → status=assinado; AI FAB opens, 4 suggestion chips work, manual send/receive works, /ia full page renders; ClientDetail has tab-quotes and tab-contracts and filters correctly. Test cleanup performed. Only cosmetic issue: CRA dev-overlay occasionally shows ResizeObserver loop warning — non-blocking, no console errors after dismissal.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. The one cosmetic finding — CRA dev-server overlay 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' — is a well-known browser warning triggered by rapid layout re-measures during framer-motion/Radix Select transitions. It does not break functionality (all clicks succeed after dismissing the overlay via JS click) and disappears entirely in production builds. Recommended one-line mitigation in /app/frontend/src/index.js: `window.addEventListener('error', (e) => { if (e.message?.includes('ResizeObserver loop')) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); });`
